verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API offers identity, accounts, transactions and balance data through a single interface, which suggests one integration can serve several data products. The evidence never says one user consent or connection session unlocks all of them without separate flows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a single auth/consent session grants combined scopes (info, balance, transactions, identity), evidence of reusing that session across Data and Verification products, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, one link session can power multiple data products — auth, balances, transactions, identity — without forcing the user through separate connection flows per product

citations.quote: Access identity, accounts, transactions and balance data for all integrated banks with a single interface.
Read account information, balances and transaction history from a user's bank.
We compare the identity data to the account holder's name for all the connected account(s) the user has given consent for.
